lead.title: Sweden's N23 Health wins MassChallenge Switzerland prize for handheld-ultrasound breast lump triage
lead.deck: The young Swedish company, led by CEO Lisa Falco, lets a trained nurse triage breast lumps with a handheld ultrasound, with no radiologist or internet connection. The Diamond Prize comes as its phase-2 study (5,000 women in Ethiopia) paves the way to CE-MDR marking.

milestone.title: Abbott wins FDA approval for Amplatzer Paraclose, first US transcatheter device built for paravalvular leaks
milestone.summary: Catheter-delivered occluder placed via a leg artery or vein, an alternative to repeat open-heart surgery; approval backed by the PARADIGM study. In Europe the device has been sold as the Amplatzer Valvular Plug III since 2020.
milestone.why: Paravalvular leaks affect 2% to 18% of patients after valve replacement: a niche indication now opening in the US, a signal for structural-heart startups.

brefsEurope.title: Roche receives CE mark for compact cobas smart e immunoanalyzer
brefsEurope.summary: Under one square meter, up to 60 tests/hour and more than 100 assays planned (cardiometabolic, oncology, infectious disease), launching in waves. A market comparable: the decentralization of lab diagnostics.

brefsIntl.title: FDA clears Deep Reasoning AI's NeuroDR for neurovascular CT scans
brefsIntl.summary: FDA clearance of software supporting neurovascular CT scan analysis, per Medical Device Network.

brefsIntl.title: Senseonics begins first human trial of its Freedom CGM
brefsIntl.summary: First-in-human trial of the Freedom continuous glucose monitor, the company's next implantable CGM.

word.definition: Portable ultrasound used on the spot by the clinician and increasingly AI-guided, to triage or diagnose without going through an imaging department.

how.t: A trained caregiver scans the area with a probe connected to a smartphone or tablet.
Software guides the scan and helps flag suspicious images.
The patient is reassured or referred for specialist testing.

word.why: VC angle: AI turns a specialist tool into a front-line tool, widening the market to areas without radiologists; the regulatory path (MDR/FDA) remains the bottleneck.

startups.name: N23 Health
startups.use: AI app on commercial portable ultrasound devices; 5,000-woman study in Ethiopia, nurses comparable to Swedish radiologists in phase 1.

startups.name: UltraSight
